answers.explanation: Users have roles, and roles grant permissions.
Permissions follow a graph of relationships, as in Google's Zanzibar.
Policies over attributes of user, resource, and context.
Roles can inherit from other roles.
Gateways do coarse checks; services do object-level checks.
Also called IDOR, the most common API vulnerability in the OWASP API Security Top 10.
Services should accept identity headers only from the gateway.
